corrections.why: Both listings say Abandoned, which is not the same as Gone, and neither says the crow's nest is gone. The status list has no abandoned value, so unknown with a status note is the honest entry until someone checks the site.

notes_for_editor: Every fact comes from two brief listings plus one Bull Lake place-name page. The brief's status gone is not supported; both listings say Abandoned, so the record should move to unknown. The record's kind platform fits the crow's nest type. Record elevation_m is still null; firelookout.com gives 3,930 ft (about 1,198 m). No staffing, fire, access or photo information was found.
